s.t: Aladdin lived with his mother in a house.
s.fr: Aladdin vivait avec sa mère dans une maison.

s.t: His father had worked as a tailor.
s.fr: Son père avait travaillé comme tailleur.

s.t: But the tailor died.
s.fr: Mais le tailleur mourut.

s.t: After that, Aladdin's mother had little money.
s.fr: Après cela, la mère d’Aladdin avait peu d’argent.

s.t: She worked hard for money every day.
s.fr: Elle travaillait dur pour de l’argent chaque jour.

paras.summary: Aladdin lives with his mother in a house; his father, once a tailor, died, and since then his mother has worked hard for money every day.

s.t: Aladdin did not want to work.
s.fr: Aladdin ne voulait pas travailler.

s.t: He did not want a trade.
s.fr: Il ne voulait pas de métier.

s.t: Aladdin played in the market each day.
s.fr: Aladdin jouait au marché chaque jour.

s.t: "You must work," his mother said.
s.fr: « Tu dois travailler, » dit sa mère.

s.t: "You must learn a trade," she said again.
s.fr: « Tu dois apprendre un métier, » dit-elle encore.

paras.summary: Aladdin does not want to work or learn a trade, and plays in the market each day despite his mother's words.

s.t: He was now a young man, but still poor.
s.fr: Il était maintenant un jeune homme, mais toujours pauvre.

s.t: One day, a stranger came to the market.
s.fr: Un jour, un étranger arriva au marché.

s.t: The stranger looked hard at Aladdin.
s.fr: L’étranger regarda Aladdin attentivement.

s.t: He had a long beard and rich clothes, and he did not smile.
s.fr: Il avait une longue barbe et de riches vêtements, et il ne souriait pas.

paras.summary: Aladdin still will not work, and he is now a poor young man with no trade, until one day a stranger comes to the market, looks hard at him, and does not smile.

s.t: The stranger was a magician from Africa.
s.fr: L’étranger était un magicien venu d’Afrique.

s.t: The magician was looking for Aladdin, a poor young man with no trade.
s.fr: Le magicien cherchait Aladdin, un jeune homme pauvre qui n’avait aucun métier.

s.t: "Was the tailor your father?" the magician asked.
s.fr: « Le tailleur était-il votre père ? » demanda le magicien.

s.t: "Yes, but my father died," said Aladdin.
s.fr: « Oui, mais mon père est mort, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: "I am your uncle," the magician said.
s.fr: « Je suis votre oncle, » dit le magicien.

s.t: "I am your father's brother from Africa."
s.fr: « Je suis le frère de votre père, venu d’Afrique. »

paras.summary: The stranger is a magician from Africa who has been looking for Aladdin, a poor young man with no trade; he asks if Aladdin's father was the tailor, then claims to be his uncle, the tailor's brother from Africa.

s.t: The magician gave Aladdin some gold, for his mother still worked hard every day.
s.fr: Le magicien donna à Aladdin de l’or, car sa mère travaillait encore dur chaque jour.

s.t: But Aladdin did not know this man.
s.fr: Mais Aladdin ne connaissait pas cet homme.

s.t: The magician went to Aladdin's house.
s.fr: Le magicien alla à la maison d’Aladdin.

s.t: Aladdin's mother did not know of this uncle, and she was afraid.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin ne savait pas l’existence de cet oncle, et elle avait peur.

paras.summary: The magician gives Aladdin gold, since his mother still works hard every day, and Aladdin is glad since he is still poor, though he does not know this man; the magician goes to Aladdin's house, but Aladdin's mother is afraid since she has never heard of this uncle.

s.t: "Aladdin's father had no brother," she said.
s.fr: « Le père d’Aladdin n’avait pas de frère, » dit-elle.

s.t: The magician said he had been away.
s.fr: Le magicien dit qu’il avait été absent.

s.t: He gave Aladdin's mother gold.
s.fr: Il donna de l’or à la mère d’Aladdin.

s.t: Aladdin's mother believed the magician.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin crut le magicien.

s.t: The magician said he would help Aladdin learn a trade.
s.fr: Le magicien dit qu’il aiderait Aladdin à apprendre un métier.

s.t: "I will make him a rich merchant," he said.
s.fr: « Je ferai de lui un riche marchand, » dit-il.

paras.summary: The magician tells her he had been away, gives her gold too, and promises to make Aladdin a rich merchant, so she believes him and smiles at him.

s.t: The magician came for Aladdin.
s.fr: Le magicien vint chercher Aladdin.

s.t: "Come with me on a walk," the magician said.
s.fr: « Viens avec moi en promenade, » dit le magicien.

s.t: They walked into the hills.
s.fr: Ils marchèrent dans les collines.

s.t: They came to a place with no one.
s.fr: Ils arrivèrent dans un endroit où il n’y avait personne.

paras.summary: The magician takes Aladdin on a walk into the hills, until they come to a place with no one there.

s.t: The magician said magic words that Aladdin did not know.
s.fr: Le magicien dit des mots magiques qu’Aladdin ne connaissait pas.

s.t: The ground shook and opened.
s.fr: Le sol trembla et s’ouvrit.

s.t: Aladdin was afraid.
s.fr: Aladdin avait peur.

s.t: Where the ground had opened was a stone with a metal ring.
s.fr: Là où le sol s’était ouvert se trouvait une pierre avec un anneau de métal.

s.t: "Under this stone are steps down to a cave," the magician said.
s.fr: « Sous cette pierre se trouvent des marches qui descendent vers une grotte, » dit le magicien.

paras.summary: The magician says magic words that Aladdin does not know, the ground shakes and opens, Aladdin is afraid, and where the ground opened is a stone with a metal ring in it, under which the magician says steps lead down to a cave.

s.t: "The cave holds gold and treasure."
s.fr: « La grotte contient de l’or et des trésors. »

s.t: "Only you can lift this stone," said the magician.
s.fr: « Toi seul peux soulever cette pierre, » dit le magicien.

s.t: The magician gave Aladdin a ring to keep him safe.
s.fr: Le magicien donna à Aladdin un anneau pour le garder en sécurité.

s.t: Aladdin lifted the metal ring.
s.fr: Aladdin souleva l’anneau de métal.

s.t: The stone came up, and stone steps went down into the dark.
s.fr: La pierre se leva, et des marches de pierre descendirent dans l’obscurité.

paras.summary: The magician says the cave holds gold and treasure and only Aladdin can lift the stone, then gives him a ring to keep him safe, and when Aladdin lifts the metal ring, the stone comes up to reveal steps leading down into the dark.

s.t: "Go down and find a lamp," the magician said.
s.fr: « Descends et trouve une lampe, » dit le magicien.

s.t: "Walk through the rooms, but touch nothing."
s.fr: « Traverse les pièces, mais ne touche rien. »

s.t: "Bring the lamp back," he said.
s.fr: « Rapporte la lampe, » dit-il.

s.t: Aladdin went down the stone steps into the dark.
s.fr: Aladdin descendit les marches de pierre dans l’obscurité.

paras.summary: The magician tells Aladdin to go down, walk through the rooms without touching anything, and bring back only the lamp, so Aladdin goes down the stone steps into the dark.

s.t: He came into a room of gold.
s.fr: Il entra dans une salle d’or.

s.t: This gold could help his poor mother.
s.fr: Cet or pouvait aider sa pauvre mère.

paras.summary: Aladdin comes into a room of gold, and though he is poor, young, and afraid, he thinks the gold could help his mother, for he still has no trade, and this cave holds treasure.

s.t: Aladdin walked through the rooms of the cave.
s.fr: Aladdin traversa les pièces de la grotte.

s.t: He came to a garden with many trees.
s.fr: Il arriva dans un jardin avec de nombreux arbres.

s.t: Each tree had stones of a different color.
s.fr: Chaque arbre avait des pierres d’une couleur différente.

s.t: Aladdin stopped and looked at the many colors.
s.fr: Aladdin s’arrêta et regarda les nombreuses couleurs.

s.t: He wanted to be a rich merchant.
s.fr: Il voulait être un riche marchand.

paras.summary: Aladdin walks through the rooms of the cave and comes to a garden with many trees, where each tree grows stones of a different color, and he stops to look, wanting to be a rich merchant.

s.t: The magician had said to touch nothing, but Aladdin wanted the stones.
s.fr: Le magicien avait dit de ne toucher rien, mais Aladdin voulait les pierres.

s.t: Aladdin picked some stones for his shirt.
s.fr: Aladdin prit quelques pierres pour sa chemise.

s.t: In the garden, he found the lamp.
s.fr: Dans le jardin, il trouva la lampe.

s.t: Aladdin put the lamp in his shirt.
s.fr: Aladdin mit la lampe dans sa chemise.

s.t: He turned to go back to the steps.
s.fr: Il se retourna pour retourner aux marches.

paras.summary: Though the magician had said to touch nothing, Aladdin picks some stones for his shirt, finds the lamp at the end of the garden, puts the lamp in his shirt too, and turns to go back to the steps.

s.t: Aladdin came to the steps with the lamp and the stones.
s.fr: Aladdin arriva aux marches avec la lampe et les pierres.

s.t: "Give me the lamp," the magician called down.
s.fr: « Donne-moi la lampe, » appela le magicien d’en haut.

s.t: Aladdin could not climb with the lamp and stones in his hands.
s.fr: Aladdin ne pouvait pas grimper avec la lampe et les pierres dans ses mains.

s.t: "Help me out, and then I will give you the lamp," said Aladdin.
s.fr: « Aide-moi à sortir, et ensuite je te donnerai la lampe, » dit Aladdin.

paras.summary: Aladdin comes to the steps with the lamp and the stones, but when the magician calls down for the lamp, Aladdin cannot climb with his hands full and asks to be helped out first.

s.t: But the magician only wanted the lamp.
s.fr: Mais le magicien voulait seulement la lampe.

s.t: Aladdin still would not give it to him.
s.fr: Aladdin ne voulut toujours pas le lui donner.

s.t: The magician was angry and said the magic words again.
s.fr: Le magicien était en colère et dit les mots magiques de nouveau.

s.t: The stone closed, and Aladdin was trapped in the dark.
s.fr: La pierre se ferma, et Aladdin fut piégé dans le noir.

paras.summary: The magician only wants the lamp, and when Aladdin still will not give it to him, the magician grows angry and says the magic words again, closing the stone and trapping Aladdin in the dark.

s.t: He called out, but no one came.
s.fr: Il appela, mais personne ne vint.

s.t: Aladdin sat in the dark cave for a long time.
s.fr: Aladdin resta assis dans la grotte sombre pendant longtemps.

s.t: Aladdin rubbed his hands.
s.fr: Aladdin se frotta les mains.

paras.summary: Aladdin calls out, but no one comes, and he sits in the dark cave for a long time, afraid and not knowing what to do, until he rubs his hands.

s.t: This rubbed the ring on his hand.
s.fr: Cela frotta la bague sur sa main.

s.t: A spirit came up before him.
s.fr: Un esprit apparut devant lui.

s.t: "I am the spirit of the ring," it said.
s.fr: « Je suis l’esprit de la bague, » dit-il.

s.t: "What do you wish?" it asked.
s.fr: « Que désirez-vous ? » demanda-t-il.

s.t: "Take me home," said Aladdin.
s.fr: « Emmène-moi à la maison, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: Then Aladdin was home again.
s.fr: Puis Aladdin était de nouveau chez lui.

paras.summary: The rubbing turns the ring on his hand, and a great spirit rises up, saying it is the spirit of the ring and asking what Aladdin wishes; Aladdin asks to go home, and at once he is there.

s.t: Aladdin said the magician was not his uncle.
s.fr: Aladdin dit que le magicien n’était pas son oncle.

s.t: "He only wanted the lamp," Aladdin said.
s.fr: « Il ne voulait que la lampe, » dit-il Aladdin.

s.t: His mother was afraid of the magician now.
s.fr: Sa mère avait maintenant peur du magicien.

s.t: They still had the colored stones from the cave.
s.fr: Ils avaient encore les pierres colorées de la grotte.

paras.summary: Aladdin tells his mother the magician only wanted the lamp and was never his uncle, and though she is now afraid of him, they still have the colored stones from the cave.

s.t: Aladdin sold some stones for money.
s.fr: Aladdin vendit quelques pierres contre de l’argent.

s.t: For a time, they had money and food.
s.fr: Pendant un moment, ils eurent de l’argent et de la nourriture.

s.t: But the stones and the money were gone.
s.fr: Mais les pierres et l’argent étaient partis.

s.t: Aladdin's mother looked at the old lamp.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin regarda la vieille lampe.

paras.summary: Aladdin sells some stones for money, and for a time they have food, but then the stones and the money are gone, so his mother looks at the old lamp.

s.t: "I will clean this lamp and sell it," she said.
s.fr: « Je vais nettoyer cette lampe et la vendre, » dit-elle.

s.t: She rubbed the lamp with a cloth.
s.fr: Elle frotta la lampe avec un chiffon.

s.t: A spirit came out of the lamp.
s.fr: Un esprit sortit de la lampe.

s.t: Aladdin's mother was afraid and dropped the lamp.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin eut peur et laissa tomber la lampe.

paras.summary: She decides to clean the lamp and sell it, but when she rubs it with a cloth, a spirit comes out of the lamp, and she is afraid and drops it.

s.t: "I am the spirit of the lamp," it said.
s.fr: « Je suis l’esprit de la lampe, » dit-il.

s.t: Aladdin was hungry, and he asked for food.
s.fr: Aladdin avait faim, et il demanda de la nourriture.

s.t: Food appeared on a table before them.
s.fr: De la nourriture apparut sur une table devant eux.

s.t: Aladdin and his mother ate the food.
s.fr: Aladdin et sa mère mangèrent la nourriture.

paras.summary: The spirit says it will grant a wish, and since Aladdin is hungry, he asks for food; at once food appears on a table, and Aladdin and his mother eat until they are no longer hungry.

s.t: The lamp gave them food and gold.
s.fr: La lampe leur donna de la nourriture et de l’or.

s.t: Aladdin sold the gold for money.
s.fr: Aladdin vendit l’or contre de l’argent.

s.t: He had a house.
s.fr: Il avait une maison.

s.t: Aladdin learned to buy and sell in the market.
s.fr: Aladdin apprit à acheter et à vendre au marché.

s.t: He was now a rich young merchant.
s.fr: Il était maintenant un jeune marchand riche.

paras.summary: The lamp brings them food and gold, which Aladdin sells for money until he and his mother are no longer poor; he has a house, learns to buy and sell in the market, and is now a rich young merchant.

s.t: One day, the Sultan said Princess Badr would walk outside.
s.fr: Un jour, le Sultan dit que la princesse Badr se promènerait dehors.

s.t: "No one could look at the princess," he said.
s.fr: « Personne ne pouvait regarder la princesse, » dit-il.

s.t: But Aladdin hid and looked at her.
s.fr: Mais Aladdin se cacha et la regarda.

s.t: Aladdin wanted to marry Princess Badr.
s.fr: Aladdin voulait épouser la princesse Badr.

paras.summary: One day the Sultan says Princess Badr will walk outside and no one could look at her, but Aladdin hides and looks anyway, seeing that Princess Badr is young, and he wants to marry her.

s.t: He said this to his mother.
s.fr: Il dit cela à sa mère.

s.t: "I want to marry her," Aladdin said.
s.fr: « Je veux l’épouser, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: His mother said no.
s.fr: Sa mère dit non.

s.t: "You are only a merchant," she said.
s.fr: « Tu n’es que un marchand, » dit-elle.

s.t: "I will ask the Sultan," Aladdin said.
s.fr: « Je demanderai au Sultan, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: His mother was afraid, but she would help him.
s.fr: Sa mère avait peur, mais elle l’aiderait.

paras.summary: Aladdin tells his mother he wants to marry the princess, but she says this is not possible since he is only a merchant; Aladdin still wants to marry her and says he will ask the Sultan, and his mother, though afraid, agrees to help him.

s.t: Aladdin asked the spirit for a bowl of stones.
s.fr: Aladdin demanda à l’esprit un bol de pierres.

s.t: The spirit filled a bowl with fine stones.
s.fr: L’esprit remplit un bol de belles pierres.

s.t: "Take this to the Sultan," Aladdin said to his mother.
s.fr: « Portez ceci au Sultan, » dit Aladdin à sa mère.

s.t: Aladdin's mother took the bowl to the palace.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin porta le bol au palais.

paras.summary: Aladdin asks the spirit for a bowl of stones, and once the spirit fills it with fine stones, he tells his mother to take it to the Sultan, so she carries the bowl to the palace.

s.t: She asked to see the Sultan.
s.fr: Elle demanda à voir le Sultan.

s.t: The Sultan looked at the stones in the bowl.
s.fr: Le Sultan regarda les pierres dans le bol.

s.t: He had never seen such fine stones before.
s.fr: Il n’avait jamais vu de si belles pierres auparavant.

s.t: "These stones are worth a lot," said the Sultan.
s.fr: « Ces pierres valent beaucoup, » dit le Sultan.

s.t: "Aladdin wants to marry Princess Badr," said Aladdin's mother.
s.fr: « Aladdin veut épouser la Princesse Badr, » dit la mère d’Aladdin.

paras.summary: She asks to see the Sultan, who looks at the stones and says he has never seen such fine ones before, worth a lot, so Aladdin's mother tells him that Aladdin wants to marry Princess Badr.

s.t: "Aladdin must bring me a gift," said the Sultan.
s.fr: « Aladdin doit m’apporter un cadeau, » dit le Sultan.

s.t: "What kind of gift?" asked Aladdin's mother.
s.fr: « Quel genre de cadeau ? » demanda la mère d’Aladdin.

paras.summary: The Sultan is quiet, then speaks, saying Aladdin must bring him a gift, and Aladdin's mother asks what kind of gift he means.

s.t: "Bring many bowls of gold and stones," said the Sultan.
s.fr: « Apportez de nombreux bols d’or et de pierres, » dit le Sultan.

s.t: "Forty men must carry them to the palace," he said.
s.fr: « Quarante hommes doivent les porter au palais, » dit-il.

s.t: Aladdin's mother went home to tell him.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin rentra chez elle pour lui dire.

s.t: She told Aladdin what the Sultan wanted.
s.fr: Elle dit à Aladdin ce que le Sultan voulait.

s.t: Aladdin knew the lamp's spirit could do this.
s.fr: Aladdin savait que l’esprit de la lampe pouvait faire cela.

paras.summary: The Sultan says to bring many bowls of gold and stones, carried by forty men to the palace, so Aladdin's mother goes home and tells Aladdin what the Sultan wants, and Aladdin knows the lamp's spirit can do this.

s.t: Aladdin asked the lamp's spirit for the gift.
s.fr: Aladdin demanda à l’esprit de la lampe le cadeau.

s.t: The spirit filled forty bowls with gold and stones.
s.fr: L’esprit remplit quarante bols d’or et de pierres.

s.t: Forty men came to carry them.
s.fr: Quarante hommes vinrent les porter.

s.t: The spirit gave Aladdin fine clothes and a horse.
s.fr: L’esprit donna à Aladdin de beaux vêtements et un cheval.

s.t: Aladdin put on the fine clothes and rode the horse.
s.fr: Aladdin mit les beaux vêtements et monta le cheval.

paras.summary: Aladdin asks the lamp's spirit for the gift, and the spirit fills forty bowls with gold and stones, sends forty men to carry them, and gives Aladdin fine clothes and a horse to wear and ride.

s.t: The forty men and the bowls went to the palace.
s.fr: Les quarante hommes et les bols allèrent au palais.

s.t: All the people came out to look.
s.fr: Tous les gens sortirent pour regarder.

s.t: The Sultan looked at the gold and the stones.
s.fr: Le Sultan regarda l’or et les pierres.

paras.summary: The forty men and the bowls go to the palace as all the people come out to look, and when they reach the Sultan's palace, the Sultan looks at the gold and the stones.

s.t: He had never seen so much gold.
s.fr: Il n’avait jamais vu autant d’or.

s.t: "This is a lot," said the Sultan.
s.fr: « C’est beaucoup », dit le Sultan.

s.t: "Aladdin will marry Princess Badr," said the Sultan.
s.fr: « Aladdin épousera la princesse Badr », dit le Sultan.

paras.summary: The Sultan has never seen so much gold, and says this is a lot, so he tells Aladdin's mother that Aladdin will marry Princess Badr, and she is glad and smiles at him.

s.t: She went home to tell Aladdin.
s.fr: Elle rentra chez elle pour dire la nouvelle à Aladdin.

s.t: "Soon you will marry the princess," said his mother.
s.fr: « Bientôt tu épouseras la princesse », dit sa mère.

paras.summary: She goes home to tell Aladdin, and he is glad; his mother says he will soon marry the princess, and Aladdin cannot wait for the wedding day.

s.t: Aladdin and Princess Badr were married.
s.fr: Aladdin et la princesse Badr se marièrent.

s.t: All the people came to see the wedding.
s.fr: Tous les gens vinrent voir le mariage.

s.t: Aladdin asked the spirit for a great palace.
s.fr: Aladdin demanda à l’esprit un grand palais.

s.t: That night, the spirit built the palace.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, l’esprit construisit le palais.

paras.summary: Aladdin and Princess Badr are married, and all the people come to see the wedding; Aladdin asks the spirit for a great palace, and that night the spirit builds it.

s.t: The new palace stood next to the Sultan's palace.
s.fr: Le nouveau palais se trouvait à côté du palais du Sultan.

s.t: It had many rooms full of gold.
s.fr: Il avait beaucoup de salles pleines d’or.

s.t: The Sultan came to see the new palace.
s.fr: Le Sultan vint voir le nouveau palais.

s.t: He had never seen such a fine palace before.
s.fr: Il n’avait jamais vu un si beau palais auparavant.

paras.summary: The new palace stands next to the Sultan's own, with many rooms full of gold, and when the Sultan comes to see it, he says he has never seen such a fine palace before.

s.t: Princess Badr walked through her new home.
s.fr: La princesse Badr parcourut sa nouvelle demeure.

s.t: Aladdin gave his mother a room in the new palace.
s.fr: Aladdin donna à sa mère une chambre dans le nouveau palais.

paras.summary: Princess Badr walks through her new home, and Aladdin is glad with his new wife, though he still helps his mother, giving her a room in the new palace, and he is kind to all the people.

s.t: Aladdin gave gold to the poor people.
s.fr: Aladdin donna de l’or aux gens pauvres.

s.t: Aladdin and Badr lived in the palace.
s.fr: Aladdin et Badr vivaient dans le palais.

s.t: But in Africa, the magician still thought of Aladdin.
s.fr: Mais en Afrique, le magicien pensait encore à Aladdin.

paras.summary: Aladdin gives gold to the poor people, and he and Badr live happily in the palace for a long time, but far away in Africa, the magician still thinks of Aladdin.

s.t: In Africa, the magician said magic words to look for Aladdin.
s.fr: En Afrique, le magicien prononça des mots magiques pour chercher Aladdin.

s.t: The magic words showed him Aladdin was alive.
s.fr: Les mots magiques lui montrèrent qu’Aladdin était vivant.

s.t: The magician was angry.
s.fr: Le magicien était furieux.

paras.summary: In Africa, the magician says magic words to look for Aladdin, and the words show that Aladdin did not die in the cave and is alive, which makes the magician angry.

s.t: He learned that Aladdin had married Princess Badr.
s.fr: Il apprit qu’Aladdin avait épousé la Princesse Badr.

s.t: Aladdin now had a rich palace and the magic lamp.
s.fr: Aladdin possédait maintenant un riche palais et la lampe magique.

s.t: The magician wanted the lamp.
s.fr: Le magicien voulait la lampe.

s.t: He traveled to find Aladdin.
s.fr: Il voyagea pour trouver Aladdin.

paras.summary: He learns that Aladdin married Princess Badr and now has a rich palace and the magic lamp, so the magician, wanting the lamp, travels to find Aladdin.

s.t: In the market, he heard about Aladdin's palace.
s.fr: Au marché, il entendit parler du palais d’Aladdin.

s.t: "Aladdin still has the lamp," a man in the market said.
s.fr: « Aladdin a encore la lampe, » dit un homme du marché.

s.t: The magician made a plan.
s.fr: Le magicien fit un plan.

s.t: He bought many new lamps.
s.fr: Il acheta beaucoup de nouvelles lampes.

s.t: "I will give new lamps for old ones," he said.
s.fr: « Je donnerai de nouvelles lampes contre de vieilles, » dit-il.

paras.summary: In the market he hears about Aladdin's palace and that Aladdin still has the lamp, so the magician makes a plan, buys many new lamps, and says he will give new lamps for old ones.

s.t: One day, Aladdin left the palace to hunt.
s.fr: Un jour, Aladdin quitta le palais pour chasser.

s.t: The magician saw Aladdin ride away.
s.fr: Le magicien vit Aladdin partir à cheval.

s.t: He walked toward the new palace with his lamps.
s.fr: Il marcha vers le nouveau palais avec ses lampes.

paras.summary: The magician waits for this day, and when Aladdin leaves the palace to hunt, the magician sees him ride away and knows this is his chance, so he walks toward the new palace with his lamps.

s.t: "New lamps for old lamps!" he called out.
s.fr: « Des lampes neuves contre de vieilles lampes ! » cria-t-il.

s.t: Princess Badr heard him from a window.
s.fr: La princesse Badr l’entendit depuis une fenêtre.

s.t: She saw Aladdin's old lamp on a table.
s.fr: Elle vit la vieille lampe d’Aladdin sur une table.

s.t: Badr did not know the lamp was magic.
s.fr: Badr ne savait pas que la lampe était magique.

paras.summary: The magician walks near the new palace, calling out that he trades new lamps for old, and Princess Badr hears him from a window and sees Aladdin's old lamp on a table, not knowing it is magic.

s.t: "I will trade this old lamp for a new one," she said.
s.fr: « Je vais échanger cette vieille lampe contre une nouvelle », dit-elle.

s.t: A servant took the old lamp to the magician.
s.fr: Un serviteur porta la vieille lampe au magicien.

s.t: The magician gave the servant a new lamp instead.
s.fr: Le magicien donna au serviteur une nouvelle lampe à la place.

paras.summary: Badr decides to trade the old lamp for a new one, so a servant takes it to the magician, who gives the servant a new lamp instead.

s.t: He hid the new lamps and left the palace.
s.fr: Il cacha les nouvelles lampes et quitta le palais.

s.t: That night, the magician rubbed the lamp.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, le magicien frotta la lampe.

s.t: The spirit of the lamp came out.
s.fr: L’esprit de la lampe sortit.

s.t: "Take this palace and Princess Badr to Africa," said the magician.
s.fr: « Transporte ce palais et la princesse Badr en Afrique », dit le magicien.

paras.summary: Now the magician has the true lamp; he hides the new lamps and leaves the palace, and that night he rubs the lamp, and the spirit of the lamp comes out.

s.t: The whole palace flew into the sky.
s.fr: Le palais entier s’envola dans le ciel.

s.t: It flew all the way to Africa.
s.fr: Il vola jusqu’en Afrique.

s.t: Aladdin's mother looked for the palace, but it was gone.
s.fr: La mère d’Aladdin chercha le palais, mais il avait disparu.

paras.summary: The magician tells the spirit to take the palace and Princess Badr to Africa, and the whole palace flies into the sky and all the way there, so when Aladdin's mother looks for the palace, it is gone, and Princess Badr is gone with it.

s.t: Aladdin came home from the hunt.
s.fr: Aladdin rentra chez lui après la chasse.

s.t: But the new palace was gone.
s.fr: Mais le nouveau palais avait disparu.

s.t: His mother said a man had traded new lamps.
s.fr: Sa mère dit qu’un homme avait échangé de nouvelles lampes.

s.t: Aladdin knew the magician had come back.
s.fr: Aladdin sut que le magicien était revenu.

paras.summary: Aladdin comes home from the hunt to find the new palace gone, and his mother tells him a man traded new lamps, so Aladdin knows the magician has come back.

s.t: The Sultan knew that the palace and Princess Badr were gone.
s.fr: Le Sultan sut que le palais et la princesse Badr avaient disparu.

s.t: The Sultan was angry.
s.fr: Le Sultan était furieux.

s.t: "This is magic!" said the Sultan.
s.fr: « C’est de la magie ! » dit le Sultan.

s.t: "Bring back Princess Badr, or you will die," said the Sultan.
s.fr: « Ramenez la princesse Badr, ou vous mourrez, » dit le Sultan.

paras.summary: The Sultan knows that the palace and Princess Badr are gone and is angry, saying this is magic and Aladdin must bring back Princess Badr or die.

s.t: Aladdin was afraid, but he asked to wait.
s.fr: Aladdin était effrayé, mais il demanda à attendre.

s.t: The Sultan gave Aladdin forty days to find her.
s.fr: Le Sultan donna à Aladdin quarante jours pour la retrouver.

s.t: Aladdin left the palace with no money and no lamp.
s.fr: Aladdin quitta le palais, n’ayant ni argent ni lampe.

paras.summary: Aladdin, afraid, asks to wait, and the Sultan gives him forty days to find her, warning again that Aladdin will die if he does not bring her back, so Aladdin leaves the palace with no money and no lamp.

s.t: He walked through the market, alone.
s.fr: Il traversa le marché, seul.

s.t: No one knew where the palace had gone.
s.fr: Personne ne savait où le palais était allé.

s.t: Aladdin walked for days.
s.fr: Aladdin marcha pendant des jours.

s.t: He came to a tree and sat down.
s.fr: Il arriva à un arbre et s’assit.

s.t: Aladdin was afraid, and he rubbed his hands.
s.fr: Aladdin était effrayé, et il se frotta les mains.

paras.summary: He walks through the market, alone, since no one knows where the palace has gone, and after walking for days he comes to a tree, sits down, afraid, and rubs his hands, which rubs the ring on his hand.

s.t: A spirit came up from the ring.
s.fr: Un esprit sortit de la bague.

s.t: "What do you wish?" said the spirit.
s.fr: « Que désirez-vous ? » dit l’esprit.

s.t: "Take me to Princess Badr," said Aladdin.
s.fr: « Emmène-moi chez la princesse Badr, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: "I cannot bring back the palace," said the spirit.
s.fr: « Je ne peux pas ramener le palais, » dit l’esprit.

s.t: "The lamp's spirit is more powerful than I am," it said.
s.fr: « L’esprit de la lampe est plus puissant que moi, » dit-il.

s.t: "But I can take you to Africa," said the spirit.
s.fr: « Mais je peux te conduire en Afrique, » dit l’esprit.

paras.summary: A spirit comes up from the ring and asks what Aladdin wishes, and when Aladdin asks to be taken to Princess Badr, the spirit says it cannot bring back the palace since the lamp's spirit is more powerful, but it can take Aladdin to Africa.

s.t: Aladdin was in Africa.
s.fr: Aladdin était en Afrique.

s.t: He saw the palace.
s.fr: Il vit le palais.

s.t: Aladdin came to the palace to find Badr.
s.fr: Aladdin vint au palais pour trouver Badr.

s.t: He found Princess Badr.
s.fr: Il trouva la princesse Badr.

paras.summary: Aladdin is in Africa and sees the palace, and he comes to it to find Badr, finding her there.

s.t: Badr saw Aladdin and was glad.
s.fr: Badr vit Aladdin et fut contente.

s.t: "The magician brought us to Africa," said Badr.
s.fr: « Le magicien nous a amenés en Afrique, » dit Badr.

s.t: "He wants me to be his wife," said Badr.
s.fr: « Il veut que je sois sa femme, » dit Badr.

s.t: But Badr said no to him.
s.fr: Mais Badr lui dit non.

paras.summary: Badr sees Aladdin and is glad, and she tells him the magician brought them to Africa and wants her to be his wife, but she said no to him.

s.t: Aladdin said he must get the lamp back.
s.fr: Aladdin dit qu’il devait récupérer la lampe.

s.t: "I have a plan," said Aladdin.
s.fr: « J’ai un plan, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: "Give the magician wine with sleeping powder in it," he said.
s.fr: « Donne au magicien du vin avec de la poudre soporifique dedans, » dit-il.

s.t: Badr agreed to help Aladdin.
s.fr: Badr accepta d’aider Aladdin.

paras.summary: Aladdin says he must get the lamp back and that he has a plan: to give the magician wine with sleeping powder in it, and Badr agrees to help him.

s.t: Badr made wine with sleeping powder in it.
s.fr: Badr prépara du vin avec de la poudre soporifique dedans.

s.t: Badr said she would marry the magician after all.
s.fr: Badr dit qu’elle épouserait le magicien finalement.

s.t: She asked him to eat with her.
s.fr: Elle lui demanda de manger avec elle.

s.t: The magician was glad and came to eat.
s.fr: Le magicien fut content et vint manger.

s.t: Badr gave him the wine with the powder.
s.fr: Badr lui donna le vin avec la poudre.

paras.summary: Badr makes wine with sleeping powder in it, and though she is afraid, she still helps Aladdin, telling the magician she will marry him after all and asking him to eat with her; he is glad and comes to eat, and Badr gives him the wine.

s.t: The magician drank all of the wine and soon fell asleep.
s.fr: Le magicien but tout le vin et s’endormit bientôt.

s.t: Aladdin came out and looked at the magician.
s.fr: Aladdin sortit et regarda le magicien.

s.t: He found the lamp on the magician.
s.fr: Il trouva la lampe sur le magicien.

s.t: Aladdin took the lamp from the magician.
s.fr: Aladdin prit la lampe au magicien.

paras.summary: The magician drinks it all and soon falls asleep, and Aladdin comes out and looks at him, finds the lamp on him, and takes the lamp.

s.t: Then Aladdin killed the magician with a blade.
s.fr: Ensuite Aladdin tua le magicien avec une lame.

s.t: Aladdin rubbed the lamp.
s.fr: Aladdin frotta la lampe.

paras.summary: Then Aladdin kills the magician with a blade, and the magician is dead; Aladdin rubs the lamp, and the spirit of the lamp comes out.

s.t: "Take us home," said Aladdin.
s.fr: « Ramenez-nous chez nous, » dit Aladdin.

s.t: "Take the whole palace back home," he said.
s.fr: « Ramenez tout le palais chez nous, » dit-il.

s.t: The palace flew across the sea and all the way home.
s.fr: Le palais traversa la mer en volant et rentra tout droit chez lui.

paras.summary: Aladdin says to take them home and to take the whole palace back home too, and the palace flies across the sea and all the way home, so soon Aladdin, Badr, and the palace are home again.

s.t: The magician had a brother in Africa.
s.fr: Le magicien avait un frère en Afrique.

s.t: Magic showed the brother that the magician had died.
s.fr: La magie montra au frère que le magicien était mort.

s.t: The brother wanted to punish Aladdin.
s.fr: Le frère voulait punir Aladdin.

s.t: All the people loved a holy woman called Fatima.
s.fr: Tous les gens aimaient une femme sainte appelée Fatima.

paras.summary: The magician had a brother in Africa, and magic shows the brother that the magician has died, so he wants to punish Aladdin; all the people love a holy woman called Fatima.

s.t: The brother found Fatima and killed her.
s.fr: Le frère trouva Fatima et la tua.

s.t: He put on her clothes to look like Fatima.
s.fr: Il mit ses vêtements pour ressembler à Fatima.

s.t: The false Fatima came to Aladdin's palace.
s.fr: La fausse Fatima vint au palais d’Aladdin.

s.t: Badr was glad to see Fatima.
s.fr: Badr était contente de voir Fatima.

paras.summary: The brother finds Fatima and kills her, then puts on her clothes to look like her; the false Fatima comes to Aladdin's palace, and Badr is glad to see the holy woman.

s.t: "Stay in the palace with me," said Badr.
s.fr: « Reste dans le palais avec moi, » dit-elle Badr.

s.t: One day, the false Fatima came to the great hall.
s.fr: Un jour, la fausse Fatima vint dans la grande salle.

s.t: She said a great bird's egg had to hang there.
s.fr: Elle dit qu’un œuf de grand oiseau devait y être suspendu.

s.t: Badr asked Aladdin for a great bird's egg.
s.fr: Badr demanda à Aladdin un œuf de grand oiseau.

s.t: "Get this for me," said Badr.
s.fr: « Obtiens ceci pour moi, » dit Badr.

paras.summary: Badr asks Fatima to stay in the palace, and the false Fatima stays; one day she comes to the great hall and says a great bird's egg has to hang there, so Badr asks Aladdin for a great bird's egg and to get this for her.

s.t: Aladdin rubbed the lamp to ask for the egg.
s.fr: Aladdin frotta la lampe pour demander l’œuf.

s.t: The spirit came and looked angry.
s.fr: L’esprit vint et parut en colère.

s.t: "A bird's egg?" it asked.
s.fr: « L’œuf d’un oiseau ? » demanda-il.

s.t: "An enemy would ask for this," said the spirit.
s.fr: « Un ennemi demanderait cela, » dit l’esprit.

paras.summary: Aladdin rubs the lamp to ask for the egg, and the spirit comes and looks angry, saying an enemy would ask for this.

s.t: "That is not Fatima," said the spirit.
s.fr: « Ce n’est pas Fatima, » dit l’esprit.

s.t: "Fatima is the magician's brother," said the spirit.
s.fr: « Fatima est le frère du magicien, » dit l’esprit.

s.t: "He wants to kill you," said the spirit.
s.fr: « Il veut te tuer, » dit l’esprit.

s.t: Aladdin was afraid, but he was ready.
s.fr: Aladdin avait peur, mais il était prêt.

paras.summary: The spirit says that is not Fatima but the magician's brother, who wants to kill Aladdin, so Aladdin is afraid, but he is ready.

s.t: He took a blade and went to find Fatima.
s.fr: Il prit une lame et alla trouver Fatima.

s.t: Aladdin found the false Fatima in the great hall.
s.fr: Aladdin trouva la fausse Fatima dans la grande salle.

s.t: The false Fatima saw Aladdin and looked afraid.
s.fr: La fausse Fatima vit Aladdin et parut effrayée.

s.t: Aladdin killed the false Fatima with the blade.
s.fr: Aladdin tua la fausse Fatima avec la lame.

paras.summary: He takes a blade and goes to find Fatima, finds the false Fatima in the great hall, and when she sees him and looks afraid, Aladdin kills the false Fatima with the blade.

s.t: The magician's brother was dead, and no one came after Aladdin again.
s.fr: Le frère du magicien était mort, et personne ne vint après Aladdin.

s.t: Aladdin told Badr and the Sultan the truth.
s.fr: Aladdin dit la vérité à Badr et au Sultan.

s.t: Aladdin became Sultan.
s.fr: Aladdin devint Sultan.

paras.summary: The magician's brother is dead, and no one comes after Aladdin again; Aladdin tells Badr and the Sultan the truth, and Aladdin becomes Sultan.
